The '''Crumbling Wall''' was the name given to a collapsing [[Prison/Legends|prison]] wall and yard in [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crumbling Wall appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
